text:
pagerbot: Pager alert: auth-service 401 spike from ~120 IPs over last 5m. Possible credential scraping. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/auth/alert/401-spike :rotating_light:

maria: ack. oncall here, dropping into triage. Do we have SRE oncall?

sam: I'm on SRE. Looking at logs now. Early grep shows repeated /session/refresh with header snippets that look like token fragments.

maria: that sounds like possible leaked debug logs being replayed. Any external egress destinations?

sam: telemetry-forwarder noticed a successful POST to external endpoint yesterday at 03:12 UTC from the staging-forwarder role. logs: `POST https://collector-external.example/ingest 200`

lee: tagging @sec-team and @legal. If external upload contains auth fragments we treat as P2 incident.

alex: I can block outbound to that collector CIDR at the edge ACLs now. Will push rule.

alex: `kubectl exec -n infra acl-manager -- iptables -I OUTPUT -d 54.23.12.99 -j DROP` (ran)

deploy-bot: egress ACL change applied by alex at 1752468250

sam: running quick grep on S3 staging buckets for auth headers. Found one object s3://staging-debug-logs/2026-03-19/collector.log.gz containing `Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...` snippet.

maria: confirmed. That's user-level token fragments in debug logs. Need immediate credential rotation for any exposed tokens and rotate the staging-forwarder role keys.

sec-team: Received. We'll kick off service-key rotation and a scoped audit. Who owns the forwarder role?

sam: forwarder role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/staging-forwarder. Owner: analytics team (cc @alex).

alex: analytics acknowledged. Starting key rotation: creating new key, updating forwarder config to use new credentials, will revoke old key after rollout.

maria: while rotation proceeds, add a deprecated policy to revoke old tokens: `aws iam update-access-key --user staging-forwarder --access-key-id <OLD>` then invalidate. Also turn off any debug-level logging in staging.

sam: warning: there's also live 401 traffic to prod auth endpoints, looks like replay attempts using fragments. We should add temporary WAF rule to drop requests matching token-snippet regex.

lee: agreed. I'll open a canary sink and block those patterns at WAF.

lee: `wafctl add-rule --name block-token-fragment --match "Authorization: Bearer [A-Za-z0-9-_=.]{8,}" --action BLOCK` (deployed)

sec-team: Running quick scan for other exposures. We found two CI jobs that archived debug artifacts to the same staging bucket. Tagging owners.

alex: I've rolled new keys into forwarder config and started a canary deploy. New keys pick up at 1752468430. Old key still valid until we confirm no other uses.

maria: important: we need customer impact assessment. Any customer tokens in the leaked objects?

sam: initial grep looks like internal session tokens only; no long-lived customer API keys. We'll do a full content search and hand results to sec-team.

sec-team: please dump list of object names with suspected fragments to our ticket. We'll run forensic access.

sam: posted object list to incident ticket INC-2026-1743. Objects: staging-debug-logs/2026-03-19/collector.log.gz, ci-artifacts/job-4321/debug.out.gz

lee: starting hands-off sequence. Oncall handover planned in 20m to @lee. Maria, do you want to stay as incident lead?

maria: yes I'll remain incident lead until we have rotation complete and forensic readout. Lee will take ownership of mitigations and customer comms queue.

alex: old access key revoked at 1752468530. Confirmed: any remaining connections using it are failing.

deploy-bot: key revoke event recorded by deploy-bot at 1752468530

sam: WAF rule dropped ~85% of the replay traffic. 401 spike back down to baseline.

maria: great. Next steps: sec-team to run full audit, legal for disclosure guidance, analytics to review CI debug log retention and stop debug archiving, platform to add egress blocklist for unknown endpoints, ops to add postmortem.

sec-team: we will run S3 object content scan, check CloudTrail for PutObject from staging-forwarder and correlate principal. ETA 2h.

legal: please route any customer-facing comms drafts to us before sending. We'll advise on notification requirements.

lee: taking over live mitigation. I'll monitor for 2h and then hand back. Oncall check: @maria remains incident lead, @lee mitigation lead.

maria: agreed. I'll open a postmortem placeholder and notify product & support for potential outreach.

sam: small follow-up: disable debug logging in the two CI jobs now: `cictl set job-4321 LOG_LEVEL=info` (done)

alex: adding egress denylist for collector-external.example at edge config and preventing future wildcard uploads.

maria: thank you team. If sec-team confirms customer tokens present we escalate to legal and support. For now treat as contained. :white_check_mark:

sec-team: forensic scan in progress. will update INC-2026-1743 with findings.

lee: handoff: I'm primary contact for next 2h: lee -> +1-555-0101. Maria will coordinate comms.

maria: closing loop for now, will update when we have the audit result. :thumbsup:
